title: ACA preventive services - basics
facts: Most health plans subject to ACA preventive-service requirements must cover specified preventive services without charging a copayment or coinsurance when applicable requirements are met.
Coverage without cost sharing often depends on receiving the service from an in-network provider and on whether the service meets the applicable preventive recommendation or guideline.
Not every test, treatment or diagnostic service is automatically a no-cost preventive service; billing can depend on the reason and circumstances of the service.
